fallback: Only arm (ii) is computable in IR v1 (absolute threshold, 354 µmol/L = 4.0 mg/dL, without the +27 µmol/L delta); the 2-fold rise needs a relative comparison and urine output is not loaded, so they are checked at screening (the funnel undercounts).
label: Severe AKI (creatinine ≥354 µmol/L arm)
text: Severe AKI: ≥2-fold increase in serum creatinine from baseline; or serum creatinine ≥354 µmol/L with a minimum increase of 27 µmol/L; or urine output <6.0 mL/kg over the preceding 12 hours.
